args.command: echo '===HOST==='; hostname; uptime -p; echo '===SERVICES==='; for s in zen-ops-worker zen-ops-updater.timer zen-ops-results zen-sentinel zen-meshcentral zen-glances zen-show-controller zen-controller-readonly-facade zen-lighting-operator-proxy ssh tailscaled; do printf '%-38s' "$s"; systemctl is-active "$s" 2>/dev/null || true; done; echo '===OPS_FILES==='; for p in /opt/zen/zen-ops-runtime /var/lib/zen-ops /usr/local/lib/zen-ops-worker.py /usr/local/sbin/zen-ops-update; do [ -e "$p" ] && echo "OK $p" || echo "MISSING $p"; done; echo '===MONITOR_FILES==='; for p in /usr/local/bin/zenmon /usr/local/bin/zen-ma-dashboard /usr/local/bin/zen-console-mode /usr/local/lib/zen-sentinel.py; do [ -e "$p" ] && echo "OK $p" || echo "MISSING $p"; done; echo '===OPENCHATX==='; for p in /opt/zen/tools/openchatx-linux-sandbox /var/lib/zen-openchatx /var/lib/zen-ops/work/openchatx-linux-probe; do [ -e "$p" ] && echo "OK $p" || echo "MISSING $p"; done; printf 'zen-openchatx.service '; systemctl is-active zen-openchatx.service 2>/dev/null || true; ss -ltn 2>/dev/null | grep -E ':18001 |:8001 ' || true; echo '===MESHCENTRAL==='; ss -ltn 2>/dev/null | grep ':8443 ' || true; echo '===SENTINEL_STATE==='; cat /run/zen-sentinel/state.json 2>/dev/null | head -80 || true; echo '===TOOLS==='; for c in restic midimonster rtpmidid-cli ltcgen rg supergateway codex-acp gemini bd ptp4l; do printf '%-16s' "$c"; command -v "$c" || true; done; echo '===GRUB_ROTATE==='; grep '^GRUB_CMDLINE_LINUX_DEFAULT' /etc/default/grub 2>/dev/null || true
